0.original: Ys Iala hungers for your assistance.

25.original: Deliver the bellfruits to Ys Iala.

48.original: Unnngh... I'm so hungry I may faint...

49.original: Fruit─a little fruit will set me aright... Will you go and fetch some for me?

50.original: Just outside the village, you'll find a hillock. Two great belltrees grow there. If you give them a shake, they should render up their sweet, succulent burdens.

51.original: The trees grow on the nearby hillock. Please hurry and fetch me their fruit─I'm liable to faint at any moment now...

52.original: A bug comes tumbling down with the fruit!

53.original: Unnngh... So hungry... Did you get the fruit?

54.original: Oh, thank you ever so much... You've saved me, hehehe...

55.original: Yes, saved me from my boredom! You should have seen the look on your face when the bugs came down! Tee hee hee!

56.original: Ahhh, you've done me a great service, mortal. If there's one thing we pixies are serious about, it's having fun!

57.original: Dull and painful things? Hate, hate, <hex:021A020203>hate<hex:021A020103> them! Sin eaters are dull and painful both, so we hate them especially!

58.original: You mortals try to fight those monstrosities, but there's no fun in that. Best to avoid them altogether, we say!
